leigh-marketing: quick ask for the launch micro-brief  we need a tiny, reproducible bench for embed+rerank to lock copy + one slide example.

leigh-marketing: scope: cohort ~140, compare rwin-open-7b fp32 vs rwin-open-7b-int8, deliver p50/p90/p99/p999, token/sec, and one slide-ready rerank pair (scrubbed). warmup traces required.

ali-runtime: got it. payload mix? short/long split? any scoring?

leigh-marketing: split ~70% short (<120t)/30% mid (400-800). include 6 cached hits to show KV speedups. ndcg@10 would be nice but not required for the one slide.

tara-devex: please tag traces: campaign=launch-mini, deck=hero, and add span annotation warmup=true/false + sample_tag for slide mapping.

noah-eng: timeline: smoke tonight (small sweep) and full sweep tomorrow evening. smoke will include p50/p90/p99 and the slide example per variant.

bench-bot: Job queued  id=90211 queue=staging-bench variants=[rwin-open-7b-fp32,rwin-open-7b-int8] cohort=140 longpct=30 ETA smoke=2024-09-08T20:00Z.

ali-runtime: repro command well use:
run_bench --cohort=mini_launch_pack.json --models=rwin-open-7b-fp32,rwin-open-7b-int8 --warmup=20 --samples=140 --trace-tags "campaign=launch-mini,deck=hero" --output artifacts/1739992222-mini-sweep.tar.gz

ali-runtime: deliverables: per-request latencies (p50/p90/p99/p999), token throughput, 6 cached-hit examples, 8 tail snapshots per variant, and README with git/model shas + instance SKU. will scrub PII; slide example kept readable.

leigh-marketing: please flag if int8 p99 > 10% slower than fp32 and grab one prompt/response diff for the slide if order changes. high priority for copy lock.

ali-runtime: understood. will post smoke artifact link here asap.
